svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Cassandra telemetry: registry, history, latest, TTL and async IO

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Cassandra telemetry: registry, history, latest, TTL and async IO
Register three independent futures per datapoint
allAsList is not a Cassandra batch or transaction.
Registry, history and latest mutations already applied are not rolled back.
Native history TTL versus latest lifetime
Latest INSERT has no TTL. A last value can survive after all history expires.
The payload ts column is not a compare condition.
An older event submitted later can replace a newer latest value.
